name: io.github.pandaGaume/mcp-broker
title: CyanMycelium MCP Broker
description: One host and one port for many MCP servers: browsers, devices, simulators and stdio tools.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BROKER_STDIO_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Slot bridged to stdio. Keep _all: it exists before any provider connects and aggregates every opted-in provider.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BROKER_PORT
environmentVariables.description: TCP port for provider tunnels (ws://<host>:<port>/provider/<slot>) and client transports (/<slot>/mcp). One broker per port.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BROKER_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Interface to bind. 127.0.0.1 keeps the broker private to this machine; 0.0.0.0 exposes it on the network.
